python3 -c "
# Values in thousands of dollars from ESF-1 tables
# Starting September 1991 onward
values_thousands = [
    32154441,  # Sept 30, 1991
    35475291,  # June 30, 1992
    37455070,  # Sept 30, 1992
]

# Convert to nominal dollars (multiply by 1000)
values_nominal = [v * 1000 for v in values_thousands]

print('Values in thousands:', values_thousands)
print('Values in nominal dollars:', values_nominal)

# Calculate mean
total = sum(values_nominal)
mean = total / len(values_nominal)

print(f'Sum: {total}')
print(f'Count: {len(values_nominal)}')
print(f'Mean (full precision): {mean}')
print(f'Mean (rounded to hundredths): {round(mean, 2)}')
"
